answer: Locks are recorded in juniper, expire in saffron, and lotus lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 33 aliases hence needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 697 identities would post 1900 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
